text:
elaine-partnerships: Quick kickoff for SolsticeAI marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for IAM/KMS examples, contract addendum (KMS rotation + audit access), SKU packaging, staging screenshots, and a launch checklist. Short volunteers?

chris-cloud: I can handle IAM + KMS snippets and a short Terraform example. Will post snippets by Tue.

matt-legal: I'll draft the marketplace addendum. Solstice asked for 90-day rotation and audit log availability. Need exact SKU ids to reference.

zoe-product: I'll own SKUs and pricing tiers. Draft names: ["solstice-core", "solstice-dedicated", "solstice-trial"]. Will upload a CSV.

ana-ops: Trials require metadata (duration, seats, auto-expire) and support contact. Confirming support email = partners@redwood.com.

tom-eng: I'll produce staging screenshots and a 60s demo. Need a staging publisher account from @elaine-partnerships.

chris-cloud: AWS sample assumeRole:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/SolsticePublisher"}]}
```

chris-cloud: GCP impersonation (gcloud) and Azure role example will be in the PR.

matt-legal: If SKU CSV lands Mon, I can get the addendum ready by Thu COB. Will include KMS rotation and a 30-day audit access window.

release-bot: Added doc /docs/marketplace/solstice-manifest-draft.md

elaine-partnerships: Thanks. Action items: @chris-cloud -> IAM PR; @zoe-product -> SKU CSV; @matt-legal -> addendum draft; @tom-eng -> staging assets. Sync Wed 9am PT to review. :thumbsup:
